name: MyDisease_get_disease
description: Get disease annotations from MyDisease.info. Large CTD chemical/pathway and HPO phenotype arrays are locally paginated with annotation_limit/annotation_offset; each section reports total, returned, has_more, and next_offset so all upstream annotations are reachable.

disease_id.description: Disease identifier. Supports MONDO IDs (e.g., 'MONDO:0005148' for T2DM), DOID IDs (e.g., 'DOID:9352'), OMIM IDs (e.g., 'OMIM:125853'), or MESH IDs (e.g., 'MESH:D003924'). MONDO IDs provide the most comprehensive results.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of data fields to return. Options: 'mondo', 'disease_ontology', 'ctd', 'hpo', 'disgenet', 'all'. Default: 'mondo,disease_ontology,ctd,hpo'. Use 'all' for complete data.

annotation_limit.description: Maximum entries returned from each CTD/HPO annotation array.

annotation_offset.description: Zero-based offset applied to CTD/HPO annotation arrays; follow each section's next_offset.

mondo.description: MONDO ontology data: label, definition, ancestors, children, xrefs

disease_ontology.description: Disease Ontology data: name, definition, DOID, ancestors, xrefs

ctd.description: CTD data: chemicals and pathways related to disease

hpo.description: HPO data: phenotypes related to disease, inheritance, clinical course

name: MyDisease_search_diseases
description: Search diseases in MyDisease.info. Use the zero-based start offset and next_start while has_more is true to retrieve all BioThings hits.

query.description: Search query. Can be disease name (e.g., 'breast cancer', 'melanoma', 'diabetes'), gene symbol (e.g., 'BRCA1'), or ontology term. Supports boolean operators: AND, OR, NOT.

size.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 100).

start.description: Zero-based search offset, forwarded to BioThings as from.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in results. Default: 'mondo.label,disease_ontology.name,disease_ontology.doid,hpo.disease_name'. Use 'all' for everything.

diseases.description: List of matching diseases with IDs, names, and requested fields
